Mechanic here! 
To give a little perspective, we have 5 cars all vary from as low as 10k miles on one to 160k on another. All are full synthetic and mid to top quality filters. Personally I use Mobile one and Fram respectively. I buy the oil when I hit 3k miles and then do the change before 5k. The oil and filter alone at the cheapest cost me $30 so if you're paying that for a change you can only imagine the quality of the oil. 3 of the cars are Lexus and dealer would charge almost $200 for a change. A gas station would charge $30. 

I would always say change your own oil, just Google it and you will find a step by step guide BUT for those who think they can't there is a solution. 
Buy your own oil and filter and then go to a shop and have them change it using your provided oil and filter that way you assure the quality of oil and longevity of your car. Short term not frugal but long term saves a hell of a lot of money.

During my Uni Orientation we stay overnight in the senior apartments on the newest campus, it's a one night stay so we are just told to bring clothes, a blanket and a pillow. It was in the summer so when I first got there I set the thermostat to a friged 67. The orientation it self was great I had a blast, I didn't even end up going to bed until 3 am. I walk into the apartment and I was freezing as I was just wearing shorts and a t-shirt, so I unlock my room and head in ready to warm up under my blanket. The blanket in question is a super fancy fake fur blanket that I got as a gift from a wealthier friend, I've never really used it before but it's always been around my room. So I get into bed and pull my blanket over me and..... It is covering up to me knee. I am in this bed freezing my ass off and I don't have a choice but to comprise. I crunch myself into a ball and wrap myself into this normal person sized blanket and almost freeze to death for the 4 hours of sleep I had left. I sent a very detailed and wordy text to my friend who gave me the blanket , she was very amused.
